name: ALGEBRAIC_DECOUPLING_OF_EQUALITY
description: Replaces the recognizable "product is a perfect square" condition with a highly non-linear polynomial condition $(x^3 + y^3 + xy) \not\equiv 1 \pmod{10}$. This condition is mathematically equivalent to $x \neq y$ only over the specific domain $\{1, 2, 3\}$, preventing the model from algebraically simplifying the rule to equality. This stops it from triggering its memorized graph-coloring templates (like DSATUR or degree ordering), forcing a generic backtracking approach that will TLE on $n=40$.
